notes.title: Super Sami Roll 2 Kickstarter Campaign Just Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/499ebb8c58c62132b12cbec3ef7891f7f5134640.png[/img]
The day we've all been waiting for is finally here...

[h2]The Kickstarter campaign for Super Sami Roll 2 has officially launched![/h2]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2 ]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2 [/url]

There's plenty to be excited about for Sami's upcoming sequel, and we've made sure to highlight all of the best bits on our Kickstarter. Check out the campaign and let us know if there's anything else you would like to know in the coming weeks!

We have [b]30 days to raise approximately US$15,000[/b], so please consider supporting us and helping us get the word out as much as you can! There's some fun stretch goals that we'd love to tell you more about during the campaign, but that completely depends on how soon we can cross our funding goal.

Super Sami Roll 2 will be [b]coming to PC and all consoles[/b], so no one will miss out on experiencing it at launch. Backing the game will guarantee you a copy on the platform of your choice when it releases. We even have a limited number of early bird discounts for our most loyal fans, but be quick, as these may not last long!

Our Kickstarter campaign even includes some [b]social goals[/b] with their own set of rewards. Please consider helping with these if you've already backed the game, as there are some really fun features that you can help bring to the game without any extra funding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/5ac565a5e8e561dea2331452d1951fc5c5ca5dbd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/12764f5016b3d5b5e907789a83c7122690a3004f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/bea26a170a4135267ab5ae9148620fb9259d40ce.gif[/img]

Want to check out the game for yourself? Our demo available on Steam will remain active throughout the entire campaign. Enjoy the first 5 opening levels of the game and get a first glimpse at our vision for the sequel.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190 ]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190 [/url]

[b]Thank you to anyone who helps make Super Sami Roll 2 a reality![/b]

notes.title: Demo for Super Sami Roll 2 available and Kickstarter date set!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/9a8978ccb9af73492f445c408e5652fcb6d69d4f.png[/img]
While the next Steam Fest won't start until the 14th, the Super Sami Roll 2 demo is [b]available on Steam RIGHT NOW![/b]
[b]Demo page:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190/Super_Sami_Roll_2_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190/Super_Sami_Roll_2_Demo/[/url]

Feel free to try it out and join the conversation about the game on Discord by pressing the button below!

[url=discord.gg/2gTgNxKW7J][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/7cf70ccd47fc619c9d64a0e4b33a617e5e51da34.png[/img][/url]


Additionally, the Kickstarter campaign will launch on [b]November 18th[/b].
Make sure you don't miss out by following it now. Even if you're not sure if you want to back the project yet, the campaign will contain a lot of new information about the game and if you follow it, you'll get a notification when it's available.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/14a37f6734f19a9599d788bfd20eba0cebb51e5a.png[/img][/url]


Follow on X for more news:

[url=https://x.com/SuperSamiRoll][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/b796b9f4e7fe913813d5c0e9fd08299d27523b32.png[/img][/url]

[b]IT'S TIME TO ROLL![/b]

notes.title: 📢Kickstarter campaign is launching soon📢
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921912/499ebb8c58c62132b12cbec3ef7891f7f5134640.png[/img][/url]
The Kickstarter campaign is just around the corner!
By participating, you will not only support the game, but you will also be able to get it at a lower price!

Additionally, depending on the tier you choose, you will have access to other fantastic rewards such as:
- [b]Your name somewhere within a level[/b]
- [b]Access to the beta[/b]
- [b]Unique skins for Sami and friends[/b]
... and many more!

Whether you want to support the campaign or are still unsure, follow it today to get notified when it launches:
